1→// hooks_claudecode_handlers.go contains Claude Code specific hook handler implementations.
     2→// These are called by the hook registry in hook_registry.go.
     3→package cli
     4→
     5→import (
     6→	"context"
     7→	"encoding/json"
     8→	"fmt"
     9→	"log/slog"
    10→	"os"
    11→	"path/filepath"
    12→	"strings"
    13→	"time"
    14→
    15→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/agent"
    16→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/agent/claudecode"
    17→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/logging"
    18→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/paths"
    19→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/session"
    20→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/strategy"
    21→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/transcript"
    22→)
    23→
    24→// hookInputData contains parsed hook input and session identifiers.
    25→type hookInputData struct {
    26→	agent     agent.Agent
    27→	input     *agent.HookInput
    28→	sessionID string
    29→}
    30→
    31→// parseAndLogHookInput parses the hook input and sets up logging context.
    32→func parseAndLogHookInput() (*hookInputData, error) {
    33→	// Get the agent from the hook command context (e.g., "entire hooks claude-code ...")
    34→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
    35→	if err != nil {
    36→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
    37→	}
    38→
    39→	// Parse hook input using agent interface
    40→	input, err := ag.ParseHookInput(agent.HookUserPromptSubmit, os.Stdin)
    41→	if err != nil {
    42→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse hook input: %w", err)
    43→	}
    44→
    45→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
    46→	logging.Info(logCtx, "user-prompt-submit",
    47→		slog.String("hook", "user-prompt-submit"),
    48→		slog.String("hook_type", "agent"),
    49→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
    50→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.SessionRef),
    51→	)
    52→
    53→	sessionID := input.SessionID
    54→	if sessionID == "" {
    55→		sessionID = unknownSessionID
    56→	}
    57→
    58→	// Get the Entire session ID, preferring the persisted value to handle midnight boundary
    59→	return &hookInputData{
    60→		agent:     ag,
    61→		input:     input,
    62→		sessionID: sessionID,
    63→	}, nil
    64→}
    65→
    66→// captureInitialState captures the initial state on user prompt submit.
    67→func captureInitialState() error {
    68→	// Parse hook input and setup logging
    69→	hookData, err := parseAndLogHookInput()
    70→	if err != nil {
    71→		return err
    72→	}
    73→
    74→	// CLI captures state directly (including transcript position)
    75→	if err := CapturePrePromptState(hookData.sessionID, hookData.input.SessionRef); err != nil {
    76→		return err
    77→	}
    78→
    79→	// If strategy implements SessionInitializer, call it to initialize session state
    80→	strat := GetStrategy()
    81→
    82→	// Ensure strategy setup is in place (git hooks, gitignore, metadata branch).
    83→	// Done here at turn start so hooks are installed before any mid-turn commits.
    84→	if err := strat.EnsureSetup(); err != nil {
    85→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to ensure strategy setup: %v\n", err)
    86→	}
    87→
    88→	if initializer, ok := strat.(strategy.SessionInitializer); ok {
    89→		agentType := hookData.agent.Type()
    90→		if err := initializer.InitializeSession(hookData.sessionID, agentType, hookData.input.SessionRef, hookData.input.UserPrompt); err != nil {
    91→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to initialize session state: %v\n", err)
    92→		}
    93→	}
    94→
    95→	return nil
    96→}
    97→
    98→// commitWithMetadata commits the session changes with metadata.
    99→func commitWithMetadata() error { //nolint:maintidx // already present in codebase
   100→	// Get the agent for hook input parsing and session ID transformation
   101→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   102→	if err != nil {
   103→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   104→	}
   105→
   106→	// Parse hook input using agent interface
   107→	input, err := ag.ParseHookInput(agent.HookStop, os.Stdin)
   108→	if err != nil {
   109→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse hook input: %w", err)
   110→	}
   111→
   112→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   113→	logging.Info(logCtx, "stop",
   114→		slog.String("hook", "stop"),
   115→		slog.String("hook_type", "agent"),
   116→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   117→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.SessionRef),
   118→	)
   119→
   120→	sessionID := input.SessionID
   121→	if sessionID == "" {
   122→		sessionID = unknownSessionID
   123→	}
   124→
   125→	transcriptPath := input.SessionRef
   126→	if transcriptPath == "" || !fileExists(transcriptPath) {
   127→		return fmt.Errorf("transcript file not found or empty: %s", transcriptPath)
   128→	}
   129→
   130→	// Early check: bail out quickly if the repo has no commits yet.
   131→	// Without this, the function does a lot of work (transcript copy, prompt extraction, etc.)
   132→	// before eventually failing deep in strategy.SaveChanges().
   133→	if repo, err := strategy.OpenRepository(); err == nil && strategy.IsEmptyRepository(repo) {
   134→		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Entire: skipping checkpoint. Will activate after first commit.")
   135→		return NewSilentError(strategy.ErrEmptyRepository)
   136→	}
   137→
   138→	// Create session metadata folder using the entire session ID (preserves original date on resume)
   139→	// Use AbsPath to ensure we create at repo root, not relative to cwd
   140→	sessionDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(sessionID)
   141→	sessionDirAbs, err := paths.AbsPath(sessionDir)
   142→	if err != nil {
   143→		sessionDirAbs = sessionDir // Fallback to relative
   144→	}
   145→	if err := os.MkdirAll(sessionDirAbs, 0o750); err != nil {
   146→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session directory: %w", err)
   147→	}
   148→
   149→	// Wait for Claude Code to flush the transcript file.
   150→	// The stop hook fires before the transcript is fully written to disk.
   151→	// We poll for our own hook_progress sentinel entry in the file tail,
   152→	// which guarantees all prior entries have been flushed.
   153→	waitForTranscriptFlush(transcriptPath, time.Now())
   154→
   155→	// Copy transcript
   156→	logFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.TranscriptFileName)
   157→	if err := copyFile(transcriptPath, logFile); err != nil {
   158→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to copy transcript: %w", err)
   159→	}
   160→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Copied transcript to: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.TranscriptFileName)
   161→
   162→	// Load pre-prompt state (captured on UserPromptSubmit)
   163→	// Needed for transcript offset and file change detection
   164→	preState, err := LoadPrePromptState(sessionID)
   165→	if err != nil {
   166→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   167→	}
   168→
   169→	// Determine transcript offset: prefer pre-prompt state, fall back to session state.
   170→	// Pre-prompt state has the offset when the transcript path was available at prompt time.
   171→	// Session state has the offset updated after each successful checkpoint save (auto-commit).
   172→	var transcriptOffset int
   173→	if preState != nil && preState.StepTranscriptStart > 0 {
   174→		transcriptOffset = preState.StepTranscriptStart
   175→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Pre-prompt state found: parsing transcript from line %d\n", transcriptOffset)
   176→	} else {
   177→		// Fall back to session state (e.g., auto-commit strategy updates it after each save)
   178→		sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   179→		if loadErr != nil {
   180→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load session state: %v\n", loadErr)
   181→		}
   182→		if sessionState != nil && sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart > 0 {
   183→			transcriptOffset = sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart
   184→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session state found: parsing transcript from line %d\n", transcriptOffset)
   185→		}
   186→	}
   187→
   188→	// Parse transcript (optionally from offset for strategies that track transcript position)
   189→	// When transcriptOffset > 0, only parse NEW lines since the last checkpoint
   190→	var transcriptLines []transcriptLine
   191→	var totalLines int
   192→	if transcriptOffset > 0 {
   193→		// Parse only NEW lines since last checkpoint
   194→		transcriptLines, totalLines, err = transcript.ParseFromFileAtLine(transcriptPath, transcriptOffset)
   195→		if err != nil {
   196→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript from line %d: %w", transcriptOffset, err)
   197→		}
   198→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Parsed %d new transcript lines (total: %d)\n", len(transcriptLines), totalLines)
   199→	} else {
   200→		// First prompt or no session state - parse entire transcript
   201→		// Use ParseFromFileAtLine with offset 0 to also get totalLines
   202→		transcriptLines, totalLines, err = transcript.ParseFromFileAtLine(transcriptPath, 0)
   203→		if err != nil {
   204→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript: %w", err)
   205→		}
   206→	}
   207→
   208→	// Extract all prompts since last checkpoint for prompt file
   209→	allPrompts := extractUserPrompts(transcriptLines)
   210→	promptFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.PromptFileName)
   211→	promptContent := strings.Join(allPrompts, "\n\n---\n\n")
   212→	if err := os.WriteFile(promptFile, []byte(promptContent), 0o600); err != nil {
   213→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write prompt file: %w", err)
   214→	}
   215→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Extracted %d prompt(s) to: %s\n", len(allPrompts), sessionDir+"/"+paths.PromptFileName)
   216→
   217→	// Extract summary
   218→	summaryFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.SummaryFileName)
   219→	summary := extractLastAssistantMessage(transcriptLines)
   220→	if err := os.WriteFile(summaryFile, []byte(summary), 0o600); err != nil {
   221→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write summary file: %w", err)
   222→	}
   223→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Extracted summary to: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.SummaryFileName)
   224→
   225→	// Get modified files from transcript (main agent + subagents).
   226→	// Subagent transcripts live in <transcriptDir>/<modelSessionID>/subagents/
   227→	// Reuse already-parsed transcriptLines to avoid re-parsing the main transcript.
   228→	subagentsDir := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(transcriptPath), input.SessionID, "subagents")
   229→	modifiedFiles, subagentErr := claudecode.ExtractAllModifiedFilesFromLines(transcriptLines, subagentsDir)
   230→	if subagentErr != nil {
   231→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to extract modified files with subagents: %v\n", subagentErr)
   232→		// Fall back to main transcript only
   233→		modifiedFiles = extractModifiedFiles(transcriptLines)
   234→	}
   235→
   236→	// Generate commit message from last user prompt
   237→	lastPrompt := ""
   238→	if len(allPrompts) > 0 {
   239→		lastPrompt = allPrompts[len(allPrompts)-1]
   240→	}
   241→	commitMessage := generateCommitMessage(lastPrompt)
   242→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Using commit message: %s\n", commitMessage)
   243→
   244→	// Get repo root for path conversion (not cwd, since Claude may be in a subdirectory)
   245→	// Using cwd would filter out files in sibling directories (paths starting with ..)
   246→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   247→	if err != nil {
   248→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get repo root: %w", err)
   249→	}
   250→
   251→	if preState != nil {
   252→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Pre-prompt state: %d pre-existing untracked files\n", len(preState.UntrackedFiles))
   253→	}
   254→
   255→	// Compute new and deleted files (single git status call)
   256→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(preState.PreUntrackedFiles())
   257→	if err != nil {
   258→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to compute file changes: %v\n", err)
   259→	}
   260→
   261→	// Filter and normalize all paths (CLI responsibility)
   262→	relModifiedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(modifiedFiles, repoRoot)
   263→	var relNewFiles, relDeletedFiles []string
   264→	if changes != nil {
   265→		relNewFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.New, repoRoot)
   266→		relDeletedFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.Deleted, repoRoot)
   267→	}
   268→
   269→	// Check if there are any changes to commit
   270→	totalChanges := len(relModifiedFiles) + len(relNewFiles) + len(relDeletedFiles)
   271→	if totalChanges == 0 {
   272→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "No files were modified during this session\n")
   273→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Skipping commit\n")
   274→		// Still transition phase even when skipping commit — the turn is ending.
   275→		transitionSessionTurnEnd(sessionID)
   276→		// Clean up state even when skipping
   277→		if err := CleanupPrePromptState(sessionID); err != nil {
   278→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to cleanup pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   279→		}
   280→		return nil
   281→	}
   282→
   283→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Files modified during session (%d):\n", len(relModifiedFiles))
   284→	for _, file := range relModifiedFiles {
   285→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  - %s\n", file)
   286→	}
   287→	if len(relNewFiles) > 0 {
   288→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "New files created (%d):\n", len(relNewFiles))
   289→		for _, file := range relNewFiles {
   290→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  + %s\n", file)
   291→		}
   292→	}
   293→	if len(relDeletedFiles) > 0 {
   294→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Files deleted (%d):\n", len(relDeletedFiles))
   295→		for _, file := range relDeletedFiles {
   296→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  - %s\n", file)
   297→		}
   298→	}
   299→
   300→	// Create context file before saving changes
   301→	contextFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.ContextFileName)
   302→	if err := createContextFileMinimal(contextFile, commitMessage, sessionID, promptFile, summaryFile, transcriptLines); err != nil {
   303→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create context file: %w", err)
   304→	}
   305→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Created context file: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.ContextFileName)
   306→
   307→	// Get git author from local/global config
   308→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   309→	if err != nil {
   310→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get git author: %w", err)
   311→	}
   312→
   313→	// Get the configured strategy
   314→	strat := GetStrategy()
   315→
   316→	// Get agent type from the currently executing hook agent (authoritative source)
   317→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   318→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   319→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   320→	}
   321→
   322→	// Get transcript position from pre-prompt state (captured at step/turn start)
   323→	var transcriptIdentifierAtStart string
   324→	var transcriptLinesAtStart int
   325→	if preState != nil {
   326→		transcriptIdentifierAtStart = preState.LastTranscriptIdentifier
   327→		transcriptLinesAtStart = preState.StepTranscriptStart
   328→	}
   329→
   330→	// Calculate token usage for this checkpoint (Claude Code specific).
   331→	// Reuse already-parsed transcriptLines when the parse offset matches the token usage offset.
   332→	// They differ only in edge cases (auto-commit with no pre-prompt state).
   333→	var tokenUsage *agent.TokenUsage
   334→	if transcriptPath != "" {
   335→		var usage *agent.TokenUsage
   336→		var tokenErr error
   337→		if transcriptLinesAtStart == transcriptOffset {
   338→			// Common case: same offset, reuse already-parsed lines
   339→			usage, tokenErr = claudecode.CalculateTotalTokenUsageFromLines(transcriptLines, subagentsDir)
   340→		} else {
   341→			// Edge case: different offset, must re-parse from the token usage start line
   342→			usage, tokenErr = claudecode.CalculateTotalTokenUsage(transcriptPath, transcriptLinesAtStart, subagentsDir)
   343→		}
   344→		if tokenErr != nil {
   345→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to calculate token usage: %v\n", tokenErr)
   346→		} else {
   347→			tokenUsage = usage
   348→		}
   349→	}
   350→
   351→	// Build fully-populated save context and delegate to strategy
   352→	ctx := strategy.SaveContext{
   353→		SessionID:                sessionID,
   354→		ModifiedFiles:            relModifiedFiles,
   355→		NewFiles:                 relNewFiles,
   356→		DeletedFiles:             relDeletedFiles,
   357→		MetadataDir:              sessionDir,
   358→		MetadataDirAbs:           sessionDirAbs,
   359→		CommitMessage:            commitMessage,
   360→		TranscriptPath:           transcriptPath,
   361→		AuthorName:               author.Name,
   362→		AuthorEmail:              author.Email,
   363→		AgentType:                agentType,
   364→		StepTranscriptIdentifier: transcriptIdentifierAtStart,
   365→		StepTranscriptStart:      transcriptLinesAtStart,
   366→		TokenUsage:               tokenUsage,
   367→	}
   368→
   369→	if err := strat.SaveChanges(ctx); err != nil {
   370→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save changes: %w", err)
   371→	}
   372→
   373→	// Update session state with new transcript position for strategies that create
   374→	// commits on the active branch (auto-commit strategy). This prevents parsing old transcript
   375→	// lines on subsequent checkpoints.
   376→	// Note: Shadow strategy tracks transcript position per-step via StepTranscriptStart in
   377→	// pre-prompt state, but doesn't advance CheckpointTranscriptStart in session state because
   378→	// its checkpoints accumulate all files touched across the entire session.
   379→	if strat.Name() == strategy.StrategyNameAutoCommit {
   380→		// Load session state for updating transcript position
   381→		sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   382→		if loadErr != nil {
   383→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load session state: %v\n", loadErr)
   384→		}
   385→		// Create session state lazily if it doesn't exist (backward compat for resumed sessions
   386→		// or if InitializeSession was never called/failed)
   387→		if sessionState == nil {
   388→			sessionState = &strategy.SessionState{
   389→				SessionID: sessionID,
   390→			}
   391→		}
   392→		sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart = totalLines
   393→		sessionState.StepCount++
   394→		if updateErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(sessionState); updateErr != nil {
   395→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to update session state: %v\n", updateErr)
   396→		} else {
   397→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Updated session state: transcript position=%d, checkpoint=%d\n",
   398→				totalLines, sessionState.StepCount)
   399→		}
   400→	}
   401→
   402→	// Fire EventTurnEnd to transition session phase (all strategies).
   403→	// This moves ACTIVE → IDLE.
   404→	transitionSessionTurnEnd(sessionID)
   405→
   406→	// Clean up pre-prompt state (CLI responsibility)
   407→	if err := CleanupPrePromptState(sessionID); err != nil {
   408→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to cleanup pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   409→	}
   410→
   411→	return nil
   412→}

   414→// handleClaudeCodePostTodo handles the PostToolUse[TodoWrite] hook for subagent checkpoints.
   415→// Creates a checkpoint if we're in a subagent context (active pre-task file exists).
   416→// Skips silently if not in subagent context (main agent).
   417→func handleClaudeCodePostTodo() error {
   418→	input, err := parseSubagentCheckpointHookInput(os.Stdin)
   419→	if err != nil {
   420→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PostToolUse[TodoWrite] input: %w", err)
   421→	}
   422→
   423→	// Get agent for logging context
   424→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   425→	if err != nil {
   426→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   427→	}
   428→
   429→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   430→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-todo",
   431→		slog.String("hook", "post-todo"),
   432→		slog.String("hook_type", "subagent"),
   433→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   434→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.TranscriptPath),
   435→		slog.String("tool_use_id", input.ToolUseID),
   436→	)
   437→
   438→	// Check if we're in a subagent context by looking for an active pre-task file
   439→	taskToolUseID, found := FindActivePreTaskFile()
   440→	if !found {
   441→		// Not in subagent context - this is a main agent TodoWrite, skip
   442→		return nil
   443→	}
   444→
   445→	// Skip on default branch to avoid polluting main/master history
   446→	if skip, branchName := ShouldSkipOnDefaultBranch(); skip {
   447→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Entire: skipping incremental checkpoint on branch '%s'\n", branchName)
   448→		return nil
   449→	}
   450→
   451→	// Detect file changes since last checkpoint
   452→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(nil)
   453→	if err != nil {
   454→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to detect changed files: %v\n", err)
   455→		return nil
   456→	}
   457→
   458→	// If no file changes, skip creating a checkpoint
   459→	if len(changes.Modified) == 0 && len(changes.New) == 0 && len(changes.Deleted) == 0 {
   460→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] No file changes detected, skipping incremental checkpoint\n")
   461→		return nil
   462→	}
   463→
   464→	// Get git author
   465→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   466→	if err != nil {
   467→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to get git author: %v\n", err)
   468→		return nil
   469→	}
   470→
   471→	// Get the active strategy
   472→	strat := GetStrategy()
   473→
   474→	// Get the session ID from the transcript path or input, then transform to Entire session ID
   475→	sessionID := input.SessionID
   476→	if sessionID == "" {
   477→		sessionID = paths.ExtractSessionIDFromTranscriptPath(input.TranscriptPath)
   478→	}
   479→
   480→	// Get next checkpoint sequence
   481→	seq := GetNextCheckpointSequence(sessionID, taskToolUseID)
   482→
   483→	// Extract the todo content from the tool_input.
   484→	// PostToolUse receives the NEW todo list where the just-completed work is
   485→	// marked as "completed". The last completed item is the work that was just done.
   486→	todoContent := ExtractLastCompletedTodoFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   487→	if todoContent == "" {
   488→		// No completed items - this is likely the first TodoWrite (planning phase).
   489→		// Check if there are any todos at all to avoid duplicate messages.
   490→		todoCount := CountTodosFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   491→		if todoCount > 0 {
   492→			// Use "Planning: N todos" format for the first TodoWrite
   493→			todoContent = fmt.Sprintf("Planning: %d todos", todoCount)
   494→		}
   495→		// If todoCount == 0, todoContent remains empty and FormatIncrementalMessage
   496→		// will fall back to "Checkpoint #N" format
   497→	}
   498→
   499→	// Get agent type from the currently executing hook agent (authoritative source)
   500→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   501→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   502→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   503→	}
   504→
   505→	// Build incremental checkpoint context
   506→	ctx := strategy.TaskCheckpointContext{
   507→		SessionID:           sessionID,
   508→		ToolUseID:           taskToolUseID,
   509→		ModifiedFiles:       changes.Modified,
   510→		NewFiles:            changes.New,
   511→		DeletedFiles:        changes.Deleted,
   512→		TranscriptPath:      input.TranscriptPath,
   513→		AuthorName:          author.Name,
   514→		AuthorEmail:         author.Email,
   515→		IsIncremental:       true,
   516→		IncrementalSequence: seq,
   517→		IncrementalType:     input.ToolName,
   518→		IncrementalData:     input.ToolInput,
   519→		TodoContent:         todoContent,
   520→		AgentType:           agentType,
   521→	}
   522→
   523→	// Save incremental checkpoint
   524→	if err := strat.SaveTaskCheckpoint(ctx); err != nil {
   525→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to save incremental checkpoint: %v\n", err)
   526→		return nil
   527→	}
   528→
   529→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Created incremental checkpoint #%d for %s (task: %s)\n",
   530→		seq, input.ToolName, taskToolUseID[:min(12, len(taskToolUseID))])
   531→	return nil
   532→}

   570→// handleClaudeCodePostTask handles the PostToolUse[Task] hook
   571→func handleClaudeCodePostTask() error {
   572→	input, err := parsePostTaskHookInput(os.Stdin)
   573→	if err != nil {
   574→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PostToolUse[Task] input: %w", err)
   575→	}
   576→
   577→	// Extract subagent type from tool_input for logging
   578→	subagentType, taskDescription := ParseSubagentTypeAndDescription(input.ToolInput)
   579→
   580→	// Get agent for logging context
   581→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   582→	if err != nil {
   583→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   584→	}
   585→
   586→	// Log parsed input context
   587→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   588→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-task",
   589→		slog.String("hook", "post-task"),
   590→		slog.String("hook_type", "subagent"),
   591→		slog.String("tool_use_id", input.ToolUseID),
   592→		slog.String("agent_id", input.AgentID),
   593→		slog.String("subagent_type", subagentType),
   594→	)
   595→
   596→	// Determine subagent transcript path
   597→	transcriptDir := filepath.Dir(input.TranscriptPath)
   598→	var subagentTranscriptPath string
   599→	if input.AgentID != "" {
   600→		subagentTranscriptPath = AgentTranscriptPath(transcriptDir, input.AgentID)
   601→		if !fileExists(subagentTranscriptPath) {
   602→			subagentTranscriptPath = ""
   603→		}
   604→	}
   605→
   606→	// Log context to stdout
   607→	logPostTaskHookContext(os.Stdout, input, subagentTranscriptPath)
   608→
   609→	// Parse transcript to extract modified files
   610→	var modifiedFiles []string
   611→	if subagentTranscriptPath != "" {
   612→		// Use subagent transcript if available
   613→		parsed, _, parseErr := transcript.ParseFromFileAtLine(subagentTranscriptPath, 0)
   614→		if parseErr != nil {
   615→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to parse subagent transcript: %v\n", parseErr)
   616→		} else {
   617→			modifiedFiles = extractModifiedFiles(parsed)
   618→		}
   619→	} else {
   620→		// Fall back to main transcript
   621→		parsed, _, parseErr := transcript.ParseFromFileAtLine(input.TranscriptPath, 0)
   622→		if parseErr != nil {
   623→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to parse transcript: %v\n", parseErr)
   624→		} else {
   625→			modifiedFiles = extractModifiedFiles(parsed)
   626→		}
   627→	}
   628→
   629→	// Load pre-task state and compute new files
   630→	preState, err := LoadPreTaskState(input.ToolUseID)
   631→	if err != nil {
   632→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load pre-task state: %v\n", err)
   633→	}
   634→
   635→	// Compute new and deleted files (single git status call)
   636→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(preState.PreUntrackedFiles())
   637→	if err != nil {
   638→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to compute file changes: %v\n", err)
   639→	}
   640→
   641→	// Get repo root for path conversion (not cwd, since Claude may be in a subdirectory)
   642→	// Using cwd would filter out files in sibling directories (paths starting with ..)
   643→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   644→	if err != nil {
   645→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get repo root: %w", err)
   646→	}
   647→
   648→	// Filter and normalize paths
   649→	relModifiedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(modifiedFiles, repoRoot)
   650→	var relNewFiles, relDeletedFiles []string
   651→	if changes != nil {
   652→		relNewFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.New, repoRoot)
   653→		relDeletedFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.Deleted, repoRoot)
   654→	}
   655→
   656→	// If no file changes, skip creating a checkpoint
   657→	if len(relModifiedFiles) == 0 && len(relNewFiles) == 0 && len(relDeletedFiles) == 0 {
   658→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] No file changes detected, skipping task checkpoint\n")
   659→		// Cleanup pre-task state (ignore error - cleanup is best-effort)
   660→		_ = CleanupPreTaskState(input.ToolUseID) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort cleanup
   661→		return nil
   662→	}
   663→
   664→	// Find checkpoint UUID from main transcript (best-effort, ignore errors)
   665→	mainLines, _, _ := transcript.ParseFromFileAtLine(input.TranscriptPath, 0) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort extraction
   666→	checkpointUUID, _ := FindCheckpointUUID(mainLines, input.ToolUseID)
   667→
   668→	// Get git author
   669→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   670→	if err != nil {
   671→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get git author: %w", err)
   672→	}
   673→
   674→	// Get the configured strategy
   675→	strat := GetStrategy()
   676→
   677→	// Get agent type from the currently executing hook agent (authoritative source)
   678→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   679→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   680→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   681→	}
   682→
   683→	// Build task checkpoint context - strategy handles metadata creation
   684→	// Note: Incremental checkpoints are now created during task execution via handleClaudeCodePostTodo,
   685→	// so we don't need to collect/cleanup staging area here.
   686→	ctx := strategy.TaskCheckpointContext{
   687→		SessionID:              input.SessionID,
   688→		ToolUseID:              input.ToolUseID,
   689→		AgentID:                input.AgentID,
   690→		ModifiedFiles:          relModifiedFiles,
   691→		NewFiles:               relNewFiles,
   692→		DeletedFiles:           relDeletedFiles,
   693→		TranscriptPath:         input.TranscriptPath,
   694→		SubagentTranscriptPath: subagentTranscriptPath,
   695→		CheckpointUUID:         checkpointUUID,
   696→		AuthorName:             author.Name,
   697→		AuthorEmail:            author.Email,
   698→		SubagentType:           subagentType,
   699→		TaskDescription:        taskDescription,
   700→		AgentType:              agentType,
   701→	}
   702→
   703→	// Call strategy to save task checkpoint - strategy handles all metadata creation
   704→	if err := strat.SaveTaskCheckpoint(ctx); err != nil {
   705→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save task checkpoint: %w", err)
   706→	}
   707→
   708→	// Cleanup pre-task state (ignore error - cleanup is best-effort)
   709→	_ = CleanupPreTaskState(input.ToolUseID) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort cleanup
   710→
   711→	return nil
   712→}

   751→// transitionSessionTurnEnd fires EventTurnEnd to move the session from
   752→// ACTIVE → IDLE. Best-effort: logs warnings on failure rather than
   753→// returning errors.
   754→func transitionSessionTurnEnd(sessionID string) {
   755→	turnState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   756→	if loadErr != nil {
   757→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load session state for turn end: %v\n", loadErr)
   758→		return
   759→	}
   760→	if turnState == nil {
   761→		return
   762→	}
   763→	if err := strategy.TransitionAndLog(turnState, session.EventTurnEnd, session.TransitionContext{}, session.NoOpActionHandler{}); err != nil {
   764→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: turn-end transition failed: %v\n", err)
   765→	}
   766→
   767→	// Always dispatch to strategy for turn-end handling. The strategy reads
   768→	// work items from state (e.g. TurnCheckpointIDs), not the action list.
   769→	strat := GetStrategy()
   770→	if handler, ok := strat.(strategy.TurnEndHandler); ok {
   771→		if err := handler.HandleTurnEnd(turnState); err != nil {
   772→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: turn-end action dispatch failed: %v\n", err)
   773→		}
   774→	}
   775→
   776→	if updateErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(turnState); updateErr != nil {
   777→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to update session phase on turn end: %v\n", updateErr)
   778→	}
   779→}
   780→
   781→// markSessionEnded transitions the session to ENDED phase via the state machine.
   782→func markSessionEnded(sessionID string) error {
   783→	state, err := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   784→	if err != nil {
   785→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
   786→	}
   787→	if state == nil {
   788→		return nil // No state file, nothing to update
   789→	}
   790→
   791→	if transErr := strategy.TransitionAndLog(state, session.EventSessionStop, session.TransitionContext{}, session.NoOpActionHandler{}); transErr != nil {
   792→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: session stop transition failed: %v\n", transErr)
   793→	}
   794→
   795→	now := time.Now()
   796→	state.EndedAt = &now
   797→
   798→	if err := strategy.SaveSessionState(state); err != nil {
   799→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", err)
   800→	}
   801→	return nil
   802→}
   803→
   804→// stopHookSentinel is the string that appears in Claude Code's hook_progress
   805→// transcript entry when it launches our stop hook. Used to detect that the
   806→// transcript file has been fully flushed before we copy it.
   807→const stopHookSentinel = "hooks claude-code stop"
   808→
   809→// waitForTranscriptFlush polls the transcript file tail for the hook_progress
   810→// sentinel entry that Claude Code writes when launching the stop hook.
   811→// Once this entry appears in the file, all prior entries (assistant replies,
   812→// tool results) are guaranteed to have been flushed.
   813→//
   814→// hookStartTime is the approximate time our process started, used to avoid
   815→// matching stale sentinel entries from previous stop hook invocations.
   816→//
   817→// Falls back silently after a timeout — the transcript copy will proceed
   818→// with whatever data is available.
   819→func waitForTranscriptFlush(transcriptPath string, hookStartTime time.Time) {
   820→	const (
   821→		maxWait      = 3 * time.Second
   822→		pollInterval = 50 * time.Millisecond
   823→		tailBytes    = 4096 // Read last 4KB — sentinel is near the end
   824→		maxSkew      = 2 * time.Second
   825→	)
   826→
   827→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks")
   828→	deadline := time.Now().Add(maxWait)
   829→	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
   830→		if checkStopSentinel(transcriptPath, tailBytes, hookStartTime, maxSkew) {
   831→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "transcript flush sentinel found",
   832→				slog.Duration("wait", time.Since(hookStartTime)),
   833→			)
   834→			return
   835→		}
   836→		time.Sleep(pollInterval)
   837→	}
   838→	// Timeout — proceed with whatever is on disk.
   839→	logging.Warn(logCtx, "transcript flush sentinel not found within timeout, proceeding",
   840→		slog.Duration("timeout", maxWait),
   841→	)
   842→}
   843→
   844→// checkStopSentinel reads the tail of the transcript file and looks for a
   845→// hook_progress entry containing the stop hook sentinel, with a timestamp
   846→// close to hookStartTime.
   847→func checkStopSentinel(path string, tailBytes int64, hookStartTime time.Time, maxSkew time.Duration) bool {
   848→	f, err := os.Open(path) //nolint:gosec // path comes from agent hook input
   849→	if err != nil {
   850→		return false
   851→	}
   852→	defer f.Close()
   853→
   854→	// Seek to tail
   855→	info, err := f.Stat()
   856→	if err != nil {
   857→		return false
   858→	}
   859→	offset := info.Size() - tailBytes
   860→	if offset < 0 {
   861→		offset = 0
   862→	}
   863→	buf := make([]byte, info.Size()-offset)
   864→	if _, err := f.ReadAt(buf, offset); err != nil {
   865→		return false
   866→	}
   867→
   868→	// Scan lines from the tail for the sentinel
   869→	lines := strings.Split(string(buf), "\n")
   870→	for _, line := range lines {
   871→		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
   872→		if line == "" || !strings.Contains(line, stopHookSentinel) {
   873→			continue
   874→		}
   875→
   876→		// Parse timestamp to check recency
   877→		var entry struct {
   878→			Timestamp string `json:"timestamp"`
   879→		}
   880→		if json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &entry) != nil || entry.Timestamp == "" {
   881→			continue
   882→		}
   883→		ts, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, entry.Timestamp)
   884→		if err != nil {
   885→			ts, err = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, entry.Timestamp)
   886→			if err != nil {
   887→				continue
   888→			}
   889→		}
   890→
   891→		// Check timestamp is within skew window of our start time
   892→		if ts.After(hookStartTime.Add(-maxSkew)) && ts.Before(hookStartTime.Add(maxSkew)) {
   893→			return true
   894→		}
   895→	}
   896→	return false
   897→}

    40→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list committed checkpoints: %w", err)
    41→	}
    42→
    43→	// Convert from checkpoint.CommittedInfo to strategy.CheckpointInfo
    44→	result := make([]CheckpointInfo, 0, len(committed))
    45→	for _, c := range committed {

    47→			CheckpointID:     c.CheckpointID,

    49→			CreatedAt:        c.CreatedAt,
    50→			CheckpointsCount: c.CheckpointsCount,

    53→			IsTask:           c.IsTask,
    54→			ToolUseID:        c.ToolUseID,
    55→			SessionCount:     c.SessionCount,
    56→			SessionIDs:       c.SessionIDs,
    57→		})
    58→	}

   106→// CondenseSession condenses a session's shadow branch to permanent storage.
   107→// checkpointID is the 12-hex-char value from the Entire-Checkpoint trailer.
   108→// Metadata is stored at sharded path: <checkpoint_id[:2]>/<checkpoint_id[2:]>/
   109→// Uses checkpoint.GitStore.WriteCommitted for the git operations.
   110→//
   111→// For mid-session commits (no Stop/SaveChanges called yet), the shadow branch may not exist.
   112→// In this case, data is extracted from the live transcript instead.
   113→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseSession(repo *git.Repository, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, state *SessionState, committedFiles map[string]struct{}) (*CondenseResult, error) {
   114→	// Get shadow branch (may not exist for mid-session commits)
   115→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   116→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   117→	ref, err := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   118→	hasShadowBranch := err == nil
   119→
   120→	var sessionData *ExtractedSessionData
   121→	if hasShadowBranch {
   122→		// Extract session data from the shadow branch (with live transcript fallback).
   123→		// Use tracked files from session state instead of collecting all files from tree.
   124→		// Pass agent type to handle different transcript formats (JSONL for Claude, JSON for Gemini).
   125→		// Pass live transcript path so condensation reads the current file rather than a
   126→		// potentially stale shadow branch copy (SaveChanges may have been skipped if the
   127→		// last turn had no code changes).
   128→		// Pass CheckpointTranscriptStart for accurate token calculation (line offset for Claude, message index for Gemini).
   129→		sessionData, err = s.extractSessionData(repo, ref.Hash(), state.SessionID, state.FilesTouched, state.AgentType, state.TranscriptPath, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   130→		if err != nil {
   131→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to extract session data: %w", err)
   132→		}
   133→	} else {
   134→		// No shadow branch: mid-session commit before Stop/SaveChanges.
   135→		// Extract data directly from live transcript.
   136→		if state.TranscriptPath == "" {
   137→			return nil, errors.New("shadow branch not found and no live transcript available")
   138→		}
   139→		sessionData, err = s.extractSessionDataFromLiveTranscript(state)
   140→		if err != nil {
   141→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to extract session data from live transcript: %w", err)
   142→		}
   143→	}
   144→
   145→	// For 1:1 checkpoint model: filter files_touched to only include files actually
   146→	// committed in this specific commit. This ensures each checkpoint represents
   147→	// exactly the files in that commit, not all files mentioned in the transcript.
   148→	if len(committedFiles) > 0 {
   149→		if len(sessionData.FilesTouched) > 0 {
   150→			// Filter to intersection of transcript-extracted files and committed files
   151→			filtered := make([]string, 0, len(sessionData.FilesTouched))
   152→			for _, f := range sessionData.FilesTouched {
   153→				if _, ok := committedFiles[f]; ok {
   154→					filtered = append(filtered, f)
   155→				}
   156→			}
   157→			sessionData.FilesTouched = filtered
   158→		}
   159→
   160→		// If extraction failed or returned empty, use committedFiles as fallback.
   161→		// This handles mid-session commits where transcript parsing may not find files
   162→		// but we know what was committed.
   163→		if len(sessionData.FilesTouched) == 0 {
   164→			sessionData.FilesTouched = make([]string, 0, len(committedFiles))
   165→			for f := range committedFiles {
   166→				sessionData.FilesTouched = append(sessionData.FilesTouched, f)
   167→			}
   168→		}
   169→	}
   170→
   171→	// Get checkpoint store
   172→	store, err := s.getCheckpointStore()
   173→	if err != nil {
   174→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get checkpoint store: %w", err)
   175→	}
   176→
   177→	// Get author info
   178→	authorName, authorEmail := GetGitAuthorFromRepo(repo)
   179→	// Calculate attribution. When no shadow branch exists (agent committed mid-turn
   180→	// before SaveChanges), pass nil ref — the function uses HEAD as the shadow tree
   181→	// since the agent's commit IS HEAD (no user edits between agent work and commit).
   182→	attribution := calculateSessionAttributions(repo, ref, sessionData, state)
   183→	// Get current branch name
   184→	branchName := GetCurrentBranchName(repo)
   185→
   186→	// Generate summary if enabled
   187→	var summary *cpkg.Summary
   188→	if settings.IsSummarizeEnabled() && len(sessionData.Transcript) > 0 {
   189→		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "attribution")
   190→		summarizeCtx := logging.WithComponent(logCtx, "summarize")
   191→
   192→		// Scope transcript to this checkpoint's portion.
   193→		// For Claude Code (JSONL), CheckpointTranscriptStart is a line offset.
   194→		// For Gemini (JSON), CheckpointTranscriptStart is a message index.
   195→		var scopedTranscript []byte
   196→		if state.AgentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   197→			scopedTranscript = geminicli.SliceFromMessage(sessionData.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   198→		} else {
   199→			scopedTranscript = transcript.SliceFromLine(sessionData.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   200→		}
   201→		if len(scopedTranscript) > 0 {
   202→			var err error
   203→			summary, err = summarize.GenerateFromTranscript(summarizeCtx, scopedTranscript, sessionData.FilesTouched, state.AgentType, nil)
   204→			if err != nil {
   205→				logging.Warn(summarizeCtx, "summary generation failed",
   206→					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   207→					slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   208→				// Continue without summary - non-blocking
   209→			} else {
   210→				logging.Info(summarizeCtx, "summary generated",
   211→					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID))
   212→			}
   213→		}
   214→	}
   215→
   216→	// Write checkpoint metadata using the checkpoint store
   217→	if err := store.WriteCommitted(context.Background(), cpkg.WriteCommittedOptions{
   218→		CheckpointID:                checkpointID,
   219→		SessionID:                   state.SessionID,
   220→		Strategy:                    StrategyNameManualCommit,
   221→		Branch:                      branchName,
   222→		Transcript:                  sessionData.Transcript,
   223→		Prompts:                     sessionData.Prompts,
   224→		Context:                     sessionData.Context,
   225→		FilesTouched:                sessionData.FilesTouched,
   226→		CheckpointsCount:            state.StepCount,
   227→		EphemeralBranch:             shadowBranchName,
   228→		AuthorName:                  authorName,
   229→		AuthorEmail:                 authorEmail,
   230→		Agent:                       state.AgentType,
   231→		TurnID:                      state.TurnID,
   232→		TranscriptIdentifierAtStart: state.TranscriptIdentifierAtStart,
   233→		CheckpointTranscriptStart:   state.CheckpointTranscriptStart,
   234→		TokenUsage:                  sessionData.TokenUsage,
   235→		InitialAttribution:          attribution,
   236→		Summary:                     summary,
   237→		SessionTranscriptPath:       homeRelativePath(state.TranscriptPath),
   238→	}); err != nil {
   239→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to write checkpoint metadata: %w", err)
   240→	}
   241→
   242→	return &CondenseResult{
   243→		CheckpointID:         checkpointID,
   244→		SessionID:            state.SessionID,
   245→		CheckpointsCount:     state.StepCount,
   246→		FilesTouched:         sessionData.FilesTouched,
   247→		TotalTranscriptLines: sessionData.FullTranscriptLines,
   248→	}, nil
   249→}
   250→
   251→func calculateSessionAttributions(repo *git.Repository, shadowRef *plumbing.Reference, sessionData *ExtractedSessionData, state *SessionState) *cpkg.InitialAttribution {
   252→	// Calculate initial attribution using accumulated prompt attribution data.
   253→	// This uses user edits captured at each prompt start (before agent works),
   254→	// plus any user edits after the final checkpoint (shadow → head).
   255→	//
   256→	// When shadowRef is nil (agent committed mid-turn before SaveChanges),
   257→	// HEAD is used as the shadow tree. This is correct because the agent's
   258→	// commit IS HEAD — there are no user edits between agent work and commit.
   259→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "attribution")
   260→
   261→	headRef, headErr := repo.Head()
   262→	if headErr != nil {
   263→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD",
   264→			slog.String("error", headErr.Error()))
   265→		return nil
   266→	}
   267→
   268→	headCommit, commitErr := repo.CommitObject(headRef.Hash())
   269→	if commitErr != nil {
   270→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD commit",
   271→			slog.String("error", commitErr.Error()))
   272→		return nil
   273→	}
   274→
   275→	headTree, treeErr := headCommit.Tree()
   276→	if treeErr != nil {
   277→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD tree",
   278→			slog.String("error", treeErr.Error()))
   279→		return nil
   280→	}
   281→
   282→	// Get shadow tree: from shadow branch if available, otherwise HEAD (agent committed directly).
   283→	var shadowTree *object.Tree
   284→	if shadowRef != nil {
   285→		shadowCommit, shadowErr := repo.CommitObject(shadowRef.Hash())
   286→		if shadowErr != nil {
   287→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get shadow commit",
   288→				slog.String("error", shadowErr.Error()),
   289→				slog.String("shadow_ref", shadowRef.Hash().String()))
   290→			return nil
   291→		}
   292→		var shadowTreeErr error
   293→		shadowTree, shadowTreeErr = shadowCommit.Tree()
   294→		if shadowTreeErr != nil {
   295→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get shadow tree",
   296→				slog.String("error", shadowTreeErr.Error()))
   297→			return nil
   298→		}
   299→	} else {
   300→		// No shadow branch: agent committed mid-turn. Use HEAD as shadow
   301→		// because the agent's work is the commit itself.
   302→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: using HEAD as shadow (no shadow branch)")
   303→		shadowTree = headTree
   304→	}
   305→
   306→	// Get base tree (state before session started)
   307→	var baseTree *object.Tree
   308→	attrBase := state.AttributionBaseCommit
   309→	if attrBase == "" {
   310→		attrBase = state.BaseCommit // backward compat
   311→	}
   312→	if baseCommit, baseErr := repo.CommitObject(plumbing.NewHash(attrBase)); baseErr == nil {
   313→		if tree, baseTErr := baseCommit.Tree(); baseTErr == nil {
   314→			baseTree = tree
   315→		} else {
   316→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: base tree unavailable",
   317→				slog.String("error", baseTErr.Error()))
   318→		}
   319→	} else {
   320→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: base commit unavailable",
   321→			slog.String("error", baseErr.Error()),
   322→			slog.String("attribution_base", attrBase))
   323→	}
   324→
   325→	// Log accumulated prompt attributions for debugging
   326→	var totalUserAdded, totalUserRemoved int
   327→	for i, pa := range state.PromptAttributions {
   328→		totalUserAdded += pa.UserLinesAdded
   329→		totalUserRemoved += pa.UserLinesRemoved
   330→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution data",
   331→			slog.Int("checkpoint", pa.CheckpointNumber),
   332→			slog.Int("user_added", pa.UserLinesAdded),
   333→			slog.Int("user_removed", pa.UserLinesRemoved),
   334→			slog.Int("agent_added", pa.AgentLinesAdded),
   335→			slog.Int("agent_removed", pa.AgentLinesRemoved),
   336→			slog.Int("index", i))
   337→	}
   338→
   339→	attribution := CalculateAttributionWithAccumulated(
   340→		baseTree,
   341→		shadowTree,
   342→		headTree,
   343→		sessionData.FilesTouched,
   344→		state.PromptAttributions,
   345→	)
   346→
   347→	if attribution != nil {
   348→		logging.Info(logCtx, "attribution calculated",
   349→			slog.Int("agent_lines", attribution.AgentLines),
   350→			slog.Int("human_added", attribution.HumanAdded),
   351→			slog.Int("human_modified", attribution.HumanModified),
   352→			slog.Int("human_removed", attribution.HumanRemoved),
   353→			slog.Int("total_committed", attribution.TotalCommitted),
   354→			slog.Float64("agent_percentage", attribution.AgentPercentage),
   355→			slog.Int("accumulated_user_added", totalUserAdded),
   356→			slog.Int("accumulated_user_removed", totalUserRemoved),
   357→			slog.Int("files_touched", len(sessionData.FilesTouched)))
   358→	}
   359→
   360→	return attribution
   361→}

   363→// extractSessionData extracts session data from the shadow branch.
   364→// filesTouched is the list of files tracked during the session (from SessionState.FilesTouched).
   365→// agentType identifies the agent (e.g., "Gemini CLI", "Claude Code") to determine transcript format.
   366→// liveTranscriptPath, when non-empty and readable, is preferred over the shadow branch copy.
   367→// This handles the case where SaveChanges was skipped (no code changes) but the transcript
   368→// continued growing — the shadow branch copy would be stale.
   369→// checkpointTranscriptStart is the line offset (Claude) or message index (Gemini) where the current checkpoint began.
   370→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) extractSessionData(repo *git.Repository, shadowRef plumbing.Hash, sessionID string, filesTouched []string, agentType agent.AgentType, liveTranscriptPath string, checkpointTranscriptStart int) (*ExtractedSessionData, error) {
   371→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(shadowRef)
   372→	if err != nil {
   373→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   374→	}
   375→
   376→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   377→	if err != nil {
   378→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
   379→	}
   380→
   381→	data := &ExtractedSessionData{}
   382→	// sessionID is already an "entire session ID" (with date prefix)
   383→	metadataDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(sessionID)
   384→
   385→	// Extract transcript — prefer the live file when available, fall back to shadow branch.
   386→	// The shadow branch copy may be stale if the last turn ended without code changes
   387→	// (SaveChanges is only called when there are file modifications).
   388→	var fullTranscript string
   389→	if liveTranscriptPath != "" {
   390→		if liveData, readErr := os.ReadFile(liveTranscriptPath); readErr == nil && len(liveData) > 0 { //nolint:gosec // path from session state
   391→			fullTranscript = string(liveData)
   392→		}
   393→	}
   394→	if fullTranscript == "" {
   395→		// Fall back to shadow branch copy
   396→		if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   397→			if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   398→				fullTranscript = content
   399→			}
   400→		} else if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy); fileErr == nil {
   401→			if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   402→				fullTranscript = content
   403→			}
   404→		}
   405→	}
   406→
   407→	// Process transcript based on agent type
   408→	if fullTranscript != "" {
   409→		data.Transcript = []byte(fullTranscript)
   410→		data.FullTranscriptLines = countTranscriptItems(agentType, fullTranscript)
   411→		data.Prompts = extractUserPrompts(agentType, fullTranscript)
   412→		data.Context = generateContextFromPrompts(data.Prompts)
   413→	}
   414→
   415→	// Use tracked files from session state (not all files in tree)
   416→	data.FilesTouched = filesTouched
   417→
   418→	// Calculate token usage from the extracted transcript portion
   419→	if len(data.Transcript) > 0 {
   420→		data.TokenUsage = calculateTokenUsage(agentType, data.Transcript, checkpointTranscriptStart)
   421→	}
   422→
   423→	return data, nil
   424→}

   426→// extractSessionDataFromLiveTranscript extracts session data directly from the live transcript file.
   427→// This is used for mid-session commits where no shadow branch exists yet.
   428→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) extractSessionDataFromLiveTranscript(state *SessionState) (*ExtractedSessionData, error) {
   429→	data := &ExtractedSessionData{}
   430→
   431→	// Read the live transcript
   432→	if state.TranscriptPath == "" {
   433→		return nil, errors.New("no transcript path in session state")
   434→	}
   435→
   436→	liveData, err := os.ReadFile(state.TranscriptPath)
   437→	if err != nil {
   438→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read live transcript: %w", err)
   439→	}
   440→
   441→	if len(liveData) == 0 {
   442→		return nil, errors.New("live transcript is empty")
   443→	}
   444→
   445→	fullTranscript := string(liveData)
   446→	data.Transcript = liveData
   447→	data.FullTranscriptLines = countTranscriptItems(state.AgentType, fullTranscript)
   448→	data.Prompts = extractUserPrompts(state.AgentType, fullTranscript)
   449→	data.Context = generateContextFromPrompts(data.Prompts)
   450→
   451→	// Extract files from transcript since state.FilesTouched may be empty for mid-session commits
   452→	// (no SaveChanges/Stop has been called yet to populate it)
   453→	if len(state.FilesTouched) > 0 {
   454→		data.FilesTouched = state.FilesTouched
   455→	} else {
   456→		// Use the shared helper which includes subagent transcripts
   457→		data.FilesTouched = s.extractModifiedFilesFromLiveTranscript(state, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   458→	}
   459→
   460→	// Calculate token usage from the extracted transcript portion
   461→	if len(data.Transcript) > 0 {
   462→		data.TokenUsage = calculateTokenUsage(state.AgentType, data.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   463→	}
   464→
   465→	return data, nil
   466→}
   467→
   468→// countTranscriptItems counts lines (JSONL) or messages (JSON) in a transcript.
   469→// For Claude Code and JSONL-based agents, this counts lines.
   470→// For Gemini CLI and JSON-based agents, this counts messages.
   471→// Returns 0 if the content is empty or malformed.
   472→func countTranscriptItems(agentType agent.AgentType, content string) int {
   473→	if content == "" {
   474→		return 0
   475→	}
   476→
   477→	// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
   478→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
   479→		transcript, err := geminicli.ParseTranscript([]byte(content))
   480→		if err == nil && transcript != nil && len(transcript.Messages) > 0 {
   481→			return len(transcript.Messages)
   482→		}
   483→		// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return 0
   484→		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   485→			return 0
   486→		}
   487→		// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
   488→	}
   489→
   490→	// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
   491→	allLines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
   492→	// Trim trailing empty lines (from final \n in JSONL)
   493→	for len(allLines) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(allLines[len(allLines)-1]) == "" {
   494→		allLines = allLines[:len(allLines)-1]
   495→	}
   496→	return len(allLines)
   497→}

   499→// extractUserPrompts extracts all user prompts from transcript content.
   500→// Returns prompts with IDE context tags stripped (e.g., <ide_opened_file>).
   501→func extractUserPrompts(agentType agent.AgentType, content string) []string {
   502→	if content == "" {
   503→		return nil
   504→	}
   505→
   506→	// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
   507→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
   508→		prompts, err := geminicli.ExtractAllUserPrompts([]byte(content))
   509→		if err == nil && len(prompts) > 0 {
   510→			// Strip IDE context tags for consistency with Claude Code handling
   511→			cleaned := make([]string, 0, len(prompts))
   512→			for _, prompt := range prompts {
   513→				if stripped := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(prompt); stripped != "" {
   514→					cleaned = append(cleaned, stripped)
   515→				}
   516→			}
   517→			return cleaned
   518→		}
   519→		// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return nil
   520→		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   521→			return nil
   522→		}
   523→		// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
   524→	}
   525→
   526→	// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
   527→	return extractUserPromptsFromLines(strings.Split(content, "\n"))
   528→}
   529→
   530→// calculateTokenUsage calculates token usage from raw transcript data.
   531→// startOffset is the line number (Claude Code) or message index (Gemini CLI)
   532→// where the current checkpoint began, allowing calculation for only the portion
   533→// of the transcript since the last checkpoint.
   534→func calculateTokenUsage(agentType agent.AgentType, data []byte, startOffset int) *agent.TokenUsage {
   535→	if len(data) == 0 {
   536→		return &agent.TokenUsage{}
   537→	}
   538→
   539→	// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
   540→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
   541→		// Attempt to parse as Gemini JSON
   542→		transcript, err := geminicli.ParseTranscript(data)
   543→		if err == nil && transcript != nil && len(transcript.Messages) > 0 {
   544→			return geminicli.CalculateTokenUsage(data, startOffset)
   545→		}
   546→		// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return empty usage
   547→		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   548→			return &agent.TokenUsage{}
   549→		}
   550→		// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
   551→	}
   552→
   553→	// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
   554→	lines, err := transcript.ParseFromBytes(data)
   555→	if err != nil || len(lines) == 0 {
   556→		return &agent.TokenUsage{}
   557→	}

   559→	if startOffset > 0 && startOffset < len(lines) {
   560→		lines = lines[startOffset:]
   561→	}

   565→// extractUserPromptsFromLines extracts user prompts from JSONL transcript lines.
   566→// IDE-injected context tags (like <ide_opened_file>) are stripped from the results.
   567→func extractUserPromptsFromLines(lines []string) []string {
   568→	var prompts []string
   569→	for _, line := range lines {
   570→		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
   571→		if line == "" {
   572→			continue
   573→		}
   574→
   575→		var entry map[string]interface{}
   576→		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &entry); err != nil {
   577→			continue
   578→		}
   579→
   580→		// Check for user message (supports both "human" and "user" types)
   581→		msgType, ok := entry["type"].(string)
   582→		if !ok || (msgType != "human" && msgType != "user") {
   583→			continue
   584→		}
   585→
   586→		// Extract message content
   587→		message, ok := entry["message"].(map[string]interface{})
   588→		if !ok {
   589→			continue
   590→		}
   591→
   592→		// Handle string content
   593→		if content, ok := message["content"].(string); ok && content != "" {
   594→			cleaned := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(content)
   595→			if cleaned != "" {
   596→				prompts = append(prompts, cleaned)
   597→			}
   598→			continue
   599→		}
   600→
   601→		// Handle array content (e.g., multiple text blocks from VSCode)
   602→		if arr, ok := message["content"].([]interface{}); ok {
   603→			var texts []string
   604→			for _, item := range arr {
   605→				if m, ok := item.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
   606→					if m["type"] == "text" {
   607→						if text, ok := m["text"].(string); ok {
   608→							texts = append(texts, text)
   609→						}
   610→					}
   611→				}
   612→			}
   613→			if len(texts) > 0 {
   614→				cleaned := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(strings.Join(texts, "\n\n"))
   615→				if cleaned != "" {
   616→					prompts = append(prompts, cleaned)
   617→				}
   618→			}
   619→		}
   620→	}
   621→	return prompts
   622→}

   624→// generateContextFromPrompts generates context.md content from a list of prompts.
   625→func generateContextFromPrompts(prompts []string) []byte {
   626→	if len(prompts) == 0 {
   627→		return nil
   628→	}
   629→
   630→	var buf strings.Builder
   631→	buf.WriteString("# Session Context\n\n")
   632→	buf.WriteString("## User Prompts\n\n")
   633→
   634→	for i, prompt := range prompts {
   635→		// Truncate very long prompts for readability
   636→		displayPrompt := prompt
   637→		if len(displayPrompt) > 500 {
   638→			displayPrompt = displayPrompt[:500] + "..."
   639→		}
   640→		buf.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("### Prompt %d\n\n", i+1))
   641→		buf.WriteString(displayPrompt)
   642→		buf.WriteString("\n\n")
   643→	}
   644→
   645→	return []byte(buf.String())
   646→}

   648→// CondenseSessionByID force-condenses a session by its ID and cleans up.
   649→// This is used by "entire doctor" to salvage stuck sessions.
   650→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseSessionByID(sessionID string) error {
   651→	ctx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "condense-by-id")
   652→
   653→	// Load session state
   654→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   655→	if err != nil {
   656→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
   657→	}
   658→	if state == nil {
   659→		return fmt.Errorf("session not found: %s", sessionID)
   660→	}
   661→
   662→	// Open repository
   663→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   664→	if err != nil {
   665→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
   666→	}
   667→
   668→	// Generate a checkpoint ID
   669→	checkpointID, err := id.Generate()
   670→	if err != nil {
   671→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate checkpoint ID: %w", err)
   672→	}
   673→
   674→	// Check if shadow branch exists (required for condensation)
   675→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   676→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   677→	_, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   678→	hasShadowBranch := refErr == nil
   679→
   680→	if !hasShadowBranch {
   681→		// No shadow branch means no checkpoint data to condense.
   682→		// Just clean up the state file.
   683→		logging.Info(ctx, "no shadow branch for session, clearing state only",
   684→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   685→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   686→		)
   687→		if err := s.clearSessionState(sessionID); err != nil {
   688→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to clear session state: %w", err)
   689→		}
   690→		return nil
   691→	}
   692→
   693→	// Condense the session
   694→	result, err := s.CondenseSession(repo, checkpointID, state, nil)
   695→	if err != nil {
   696→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to condense session: %w", err)
   697→	}
   698→
   699→	logging.Info(ctx, "session condensed by ID",
   700→		slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   701→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
   702→		slog.Int("checkpoints_condensed", result.CheckpointsCount),
   703→	)
   704→
   705→	// Update session state: reset step count and transition to idle
   706→	state.StepCount = 0
   707→	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
   708→	state.Phase = session.PhaseIdle
   709→	state.LastCheckpointID = checkpointID
   710→	state.AttributionBaseCommit = state.BaseCommit
   711→	state.PromptAttributions = nil
   712→	state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
   713→
   714→	if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
   715→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", err)
   716→	}
   717→
   718→	// Clean up shadow branch if no other sessions need it
   719→	if err := s.cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(repo, shadowBranchName, sessionID); err != nil {
   720→		logging.Warn(ctx, "failed to clean up shadow branch",
   721→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   722→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   723→		)
   724→		// Non-fatal: condensation succeeded, shadow branch cleanup is best-effort
   725→	}
   726→
   727→	return nil
   728→}
   729→
   730→// cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused deletes a shadow branch if no other active sessions reference it.
   731→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(_ *git.Repository, shadowBranchName, excludeSessionID string) error {
   732→	// List all session states to check if any other session uses this shadow branch
   733→	allStates, err := s.listAllSessionStates()
   734→	if err != nil {
   735→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to list session states: %w", err)
   736→	}
   737→
   738→	for _, state := range allStates {
   739→		if state.SessionID == excludeSessionID {
   740→			continue
   741→		}
   742→		otherShadow := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   743→		if otherShadow == shadowBranchName && state.StepCount > 0 {
   744→			// Another session still needs this shadow branch
   745→			return nil
   746→		}
   747→	}
   748→
   749→	// No other sessions need it, delete the shadow branch via CLI
   750→	// (go-git v5's RemoveReference doesn't persist with packed refs/worktrees)
   751→	if err := DeleteBranchCLI(shadowBranchName); err != nil {
   752→		// Branch already gone is not an error
   753→		if errors.Is(err, ErrBranchNotFound) {
   754→			return nil
   755→		}
   756→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove shadow branch: %w", err)
   757→	}
   758→	return nil
   759→}

    40→// Checkpoints are stored at sharded paths: <id[:2]>/<id[2:]>/
    41→//

    43→//   - For incremental checkpoints: checkpoints/NNN-<tool-use-id>.json
    44→//   - For final checkpoints: checkpoint.json and agent-<agent-id>.jsonl
    45→func (s *GitStore) WriteCommitted(ctx context.Context, opts WriteCommittedOptions) error {
    46→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use

    59→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid checkpoint options: %w", err)
    60→	}

    62→	// Ensure sessions branch exists
    63→	if err := s.ensureSessionsBranch(); err != nil {
    64→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to ensure sessions branch: %w", err)
    65→	}

    67→	// Get current branch tip and flatten tree
    68→	ref, entries, err := s.getSessionsBranchEntries()
    69→	if err != nil {
    70→		return err
    71→	}
    72→
    73→	// Use sharded path: <id[:2]>/<id[2:]>/
    74→	basePath := opts.CheckpointID.Path() + "/"
    75→
    76→	// Track task metadata path for commit trailer
    77→	var taskMetadataPath string
    78→

1→// Package checkpoint provides types and interfaces for checkpoint storage.
     2→//
     3→// A Checkpoint captures a point-in-time within a session, containing either
     4→// full state (Temporary) or metadata with a commit reference (Committed).
     5→//
     6→// See docs/architecture/sessions-and-checkpoints.md for the full domain model.
     7→package checkpoint
     8→
     9→import (
    10→	"context"
    11→	"errors"
    12→	"time"
    13→
    14→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/agent"
    15→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/id"
    16→
    17→	"github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing"
    18→)
    19→
    20→// Errors returned by checkpoint operations.
    21→var (
    22→	// ErrCheckpointNotFound is returned when a checkpoint ID doesn't exist.
    23→	ErrCheckpointNotFound = errors.New("checkpoint not found")
    24→
    25→	// ErrNoTranscript is returned when a checkpoint exists but has no transcript.
    26→	ErrNoTranscript = errors.New("no transcript found for checkpoint")
    27→)
    28→
    29→// Checkpoint represents a save point within a session.
    30→type Checkpoint struct {
    31→	// ID is the unique checkpoint identifier
    32→	ID string
    33→
    34→	// SessionID is the session this checkpoint belongs to
    35→	SessionID string
    36→
    37→	// Timestamp is when this checkpoint was created
    38→	Timestamp time.Time
    39→
    40→	// Type indicates temporary (full state) or committed (metadata only)
    41→	Type Type
    42→
    43→	// Message is a human-readable description of the checkpoint
    44→	Message string
    45→}
    46→
    47→// Type indicates the storage location and lifecycle of a checkpoint.
    48→type Type int
    49→
    50→const (
    51→	// Temporary checkpoints contain full state (code + metadata) and are stored
    52→	// on shadow branches (entire/<commit-hash>). Used for intra-session rewind.
    53→	Temporary Type = iota
    54→
    55→	// Committed checkpoints contain metadata + commit reference and are stored
    56→	// on the entire/checkpoints/v1 branch. They are the permanent record.
    57→	Committed
    58→)
    59→
    60→// Store provides low-level primitives for reading and writing checkpoints.
    61→// This is used by strategies to implement their storage approach.
    62→//
    63→// The interface matches the GitStore implementation signatures directly:
    64→// - WriteTemporary takes WriteTemporaryOptions and returns a result with commit hash and skip status
    65→// - ReadTemporary takes baseCommit (not sessionID) since shadow branches are keyed by commit
    66→// - List methods return implementation-specific info types for richer data
    67→type Store interface {
    68→	// WriteTemporary writes a temporary checkpoint (full state) to a shadow branch.
    69→	// Shadow branches are named entire/<base-commit-short-hash>.
    70→	// Returns a result containing the commit hash and whether the checkpoint was skipped.
    71→	// Checkpoints are skipped (deduplicated) when the tree hash matches the previous checkpoint.
    72→	WriteTemporary(ctx context.Context, opts WriteTemporaryOptions) (WriteTemporaryResult, error)
    73→
    74→	// ReadTemporary reads the latest checkpoint from a shadow branch.
    75→	// baseCommit is the commit hash the session is based on.
    76→	// worktreeID is the internal git worktree identifier (empty for main worktree).
    77→	// Returns nil, nil if the shadow branch doesn't exist.
    78→	ReadTemporary(ctx context.Context, baseCommit, worktreeID string) (*ReadTemporaryResult, error)
    79→
    80→	// ListTemporary lists all shadow branches with their checkpoint info.
    81→	ListTemporary(ctx context.Context) ([]TemporaryInfo, error)
    82→
    83→	// WriteCommitted writes a committed checkpoint to the entire/checkpoints/v1 branch.
    84→	// Checkpoints are stored at sharded paths: <id[:2]>/<id[2:]>/
    85→	WriteCommitted(ctx context.Context, opts WriteCommittedOptions) error
    86→
    87→	// ReadCommitted reads a committed checkpoint's summary by ID.
    88→	// Returns only the CheckpointSummary (paths + aggregated stats), not actual content.
    89→	// Use ReadSessionContent to read actual transcript/prompts/context.
    90→	// Returns nil, nil if the checkpoint does not exist.
    91→	ReadCommitted(ctx context.Context, checkpointID id.CheckpointID) (*CheckpointSummary, error)
    92→
    93→	// ReadSessionContent reads the actual content for a specific session within a checkpoint.
    94→	// sessionIndex is 0-based (0 for first session, 1 for second, etc.).
    95→	// Returns the session's metadata, transcript, prompts, and context.
    96→	ReadSessionContent(ctx context.Context, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, sessionIndex int) (*SessionContent, error)
    97→
    98→	// ReadSessionContentByID reads a session's content by its session ID.
    99→	// Useful when you have the session ID but don't know its index within the checkpoint.
   100→	ReadSessionContentByID(ctx context.Context, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, sessionID string) (*SessionContent, error)
   101→
   102→	// ListCommitted lists all committed checkpoints.
   103→	ListCommitted(ctx context.Context) ([]CommittedInfo, error)
   104→
   105→	// UpdateCommitted replaces the transcript, prompts, and context for an existing
   106→	// committed checkpoint. Used at stop time to finalize checkpoints with the full
   107→	// session transcript (prompt to stop event).
   108→	// Returns ErrCheckpointNotFound if the checkpoint doesn't exist.
   109→	UpdateCommitted(ctx context.Context, opts UpdateCommittedOptions) error
   110→}
   111→
   112→// WriteTemporaryResult contains the result of writing a temporary checkpoint.
   113→type WriteTemporaryResult struct {
   114→	// CommitHash is the hash of the created or existing checkpoint commit
   115→	CommitHash plumbing.Hash
   116→
   117→	// Skipped is true if the checkpoint was skipped due to no changes
   118→	// (tree hash matched the previous checkpoint)
   119→	Skipped bool
   120→}
   121→
   122→// WriteTemporaryOptions contains options for writing a temporary checkpoint.
   123→type WriteTemporaryOptions struct {
   124→	// SessionID is the session identifier
   125→	SessionID string
   126→
   127→	// BaseCommit is the commit hash this session is based on
   128→	BaseCommit string
   129→
   130→	// WorktreeID is the internal git worktree identifier (empty for main worktree)
   131→	// Used to create worktree-specific shadow branch names
   132→	WorktreeID string
   133→
   134→	// ModifiedFiles are files that have been modified (relative paths)
   135→	ModifiedFiles []string
   136→
   137→	// NewFiles are files that have been created (relative paths)
   138→	NewFiles []string
   139→
   140→	// DeletedFiles are files that have been deleted (relative paths)
   141→	DeletedFiles []string
   142→
   143→	// MetadataDir is the relative path to the metadata directory
   144→	MetadataDir string
   145→
   146→	// MetadataDirAbs is the absolute path to the metadata directory
   147→	MetadataDirAbs string
   148→
   149→	// CommitMessage is the commit subject line
   150→	CommitMessage string
   151→
   152→	// AuthorName is the name to use for commits
   153→	AuthorName string
   154→
   155→	// AuthorEmail is the email to use for commits
   156→	AuthorEmail string
   157→
   158→	// IsFirstCheckpoint indicates if this is the first checkpoint of the session
   159→	// When true, all working directory files are captured (not just modified)
   160→	IsFirstCheckpoint bool
   161→}
   162→
   163→// ReadTemporaryResult contains the result of reading a temporary checkpoint.
   164→type ReadTemporaryResult struct {
   165→	// CommitHash is the hash of the checkpoint commit
   166→	CommitHash plumbing.Hash
   167→
   168→	// TreeHash is the hash of the tree containing the checkpoint state
   169→	TreeHash plumbing.Hash
   170→
   171→	// SessionID is the session identifier from the commit trailer

   173→
   174→	// MetadataDir is the metadata directory path from the commit trailer

   176→
   177→	// Timestamp is when the checkpoint was created
   178→	Timestamp time.Time
   179→}
   180→
   181→// TemporaryInfo contains summary information about a shadow branch.
   182→type TemporaryInfo struct {
   183→	// BranchName is the full branch name (e.g., "entire/abc1234")
   184→	BranchName string
   185→
   186→	// BaseCommit is the short commit hash this branch is based on
   187→	BaseCommit string
   188→
   189→	// LatestCommit is the hash of the latest commit on the branch
   190→	LatestCommit plumbing.Hash
   191→
   192→	// SessionID is the session identifier from the latest commit
   193→	SessionID string
   194→
   195→	// Timestamp is when the latest checkpoint was created
   196→	Timestamp time.Time
   197→}
